note: The strategy program of the manager-less testnet fund (npm run demo:auto), source in strategy/. `strategy` is the mandate's strategy object: OutLayer runs the wasm with this sha256 in a TEE. `quote_signer` is the stand-in 1Click key the program signs its testnet quotes with (1Click has no testnet); a fund using this strategy must be created with it. The fund's tokens must be [a 6-decimal dollar token, wNEAR]. The program parks a trade's input at the deposit address hex(sha256("plinth-strategy-deposit:<fund>:<trade id>")) and expects a solver to push the output with msg trade:<id>.
